reading.title: Bacterial Communication and Quorum Sensing
reading.passage: Bacteria were long considered simple, solitary organisms incapable of complex behavior. However, recent microbiological research has revealed that bacteria engage in sophisticated chemical communication known as quorum sensing. This process allows bacterial cells to detect and respond to population density by monitoring the concentration of signaling molecules called autoinducers. When a certain threshold of autoinducers is reached, bacteria collectively alter their behavior, activating genes responsible for bioluminescence, antibiotic production, or virulence. For example, the bacterium Vibrio fischeri produces light only when its population density becomes sufficiently high, a phenomenon that would be impossible for isolated cells. This collective behavior, termed phenotypic plasticity, demonstrates that bacteria possess a rudimentary form of intelligence and social organization. Furthermore, quorum sensing plays a critical role in pathogenic biofilm formation, wherein bacteria coordinate to create protective matrices that resist antibiotics. Understanding these mechanisms has profound implications for developing novel therapeutic strategies to combat bacterial infections without triggering antibiotic resistance.

vocabulary.meaning_ko: 박테리아가 신호 분자의 농도를 감지하여 개체군 밀도를 인식하는 통신 과정
박테리아 세포 간 신호 전달에 사용되는 화학 물질
환경 조건에 따라 형질이 변하는 생물의 능력

questions.q: According to the passage, what is quorum sensing?
options: A simple process of bacterial reproduction
A chemical communication system that allows bacteria to detect population density
The ability of bacteria to produce antibiotics independently
A mechanism that prevents bacterial cells from interacting with one another
questions.explanation: 지문에서 quorum sensing은 '박테리아가 신호 분자의 농도를 모니터링하여 개체군 밀도를 감지하고 반응할 수 있게 하는 화학 통신 과정'으로 정의됩니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about Vibrio fischeri?
options: It produces light regardless of population density
It is incapable of phenotypic plasticity
Its light production is dependent on reaching a critical population threshold
It does not participate in quorum sensing
questions.explanation: 지문에서 Vibrio fischeri는 '개체군 밀도가 충분히 높을 때만 빛을 생성한다'고 명시되어 있으며, 이는 쿼럼 센싱이 작동하는 구체적 예시입니다.

questions.q: The word 'sophisticated' in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to
options: Simple and primitive
Complex and well-developed
Limited and restricted
Random and unpredictable
questions.explanation: 'Sophisticated'은 '정교하고 복잡한'을 의미하며, 박테리아의 고급 통신 시스템을 설명하는 문맥에서 'complex and well-developed'이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.q: Why does the author mention biofilm formation in the final sentence?
options: To criticize bacterial behavior as harmful
To demonstrate a practical application of quorum sensing and its importance in understanding infections
To suggest that bacteria are incapable of organization
To prove that antibiotics are ineffective against all bacteria
questions.explanation: 저자는 biofilm 형성을 언급함으로써 quorum sensing의 실제 임상적 중요성을 보여주고, 항생제 내성을 극복하기 위한 새로운 치료 전략 개발의 필요성을 강조합니다.

writing.task: 다음 문장들을 패러프레이즈하고 TOEFL Writing Independent Task로 활용하기

sentences.original: Bacteria were long considered simple, solitary organisms incapable of complex behavior.
sentences.paraphrase: For many years, bacteria have been regarded as elementary life forms that lacked the ability to exhibit intricate behavioral patterns.
sentences.tip: 장형용사(complex) → 동치 명사(intricate behavioral patterns), 부사 구조 재배열

sentences.original: This process allows bacterial cells to detect and respond to population density by monitoring the concentration of signaling molecules called autoinducers.
sentences.paraphrase: By tracking the levels of signaling molecules known as autoinducers, bacteria are enabled to perceive and act upon changes in their population density.
sentences.tip: 능동 → 수동(are enabled), 전치사 구 재구성(by monitoring → By tracking)

sentences.original: When a certain threshold of autoinducers is reached, bacteria collectively alter their behavior, activating genes responsible for bioluminescence, antibiotic production, or virulence.
sentences.paraphrase: Upon attaining a critical concentration of autoinducers, bacterial populations undergo coordinated behavioral modifications that trigger genes accountable for light emission, antimicrobial synthesis, or pathogenicity.
sentences.tip: 동의어 치환(threshold → critical concentration, activate → trigger, virulence → pathogenicity) 및 명사구 확장

sentences.original: This collective behavior, termed phenotypic plasticity, demonstrates that bacteria possess a rudimentary form of intelligence and social organization.
sentences.paraphrase: Such coordinated conduct, referred to as phenotypic plasticity, provides evidence that bacteria exhibit elementary cognitive capacities and organizational structures.
sentences.tip: 동의어 치환(collective → coordinated, possess → exhibit, rudimentary → elementary) 및 동사 재배열

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study alone, while others prefer to study in groups. Which study method do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
model_sentences: I personally prefer studying in groups because I believe collaborative learning creates more dynamic and engaging educational experiences.
First, when I study with peers, we can discuss difficult concepts and help each other understand complex ideas that might be confusing when studying alone.
For instance, in my biology class last semester, my study group helped me understand cellular respiration by explaining it in different ways until it finally made sense to me.
Additionally, group study sessions keep me more motivated and accountable, since I don't want to let my teammates down.
Overall, while solo studying has its benefits for focused concentration, I find that group study sessions provide better learning outcomes and help me retain information more effectively.

listening.title: Student Registration Problem
listening.script: Student: Professor Kim, I'm really concerned. I tried to register for your Advanced Microbiology course this morning, but the system shows it's already full. The course registration period closed yesterday, and I'm worried I won't be able to take it this semester. This class is required for my major. Professor: I understand your frustration. Unfortunately, the registration system was at capacity quickly this year. However, I can add you to the waitlist if you'd like. Typically, one or two students drop the course before it begins. Student: Oh, that's helpful! How many people are ahead of me on the waitlist? Professor: Currently, there are three students. But honestly, based on previous semesters, there's a good chance you'll get in. Alternatively, I'm teaching the same course next spring, and it's less popular. You could take it then instead. Student: I appreciate the suggestion, but I was hoping to take it this semester to stay on schedule with my graduation plan. I'll definitely get on the waitlist. Professor: Good decision. Just make sure to check your email regularly after the semester starts. We'll notify you immediately if a spot opens up.

questions.q: What is the main problem the student is facing?
options: The course is offered only in the spring semester
The Advanced Microbiology course is full and registration has closed
The student doesn't understand the course requirements
The professor is not available to teach the course
questions.explanation: 학생은 수강신청이 마감되었는데 Advanced Microbiology 수업이 이미 정원이 차서 등록할 수 없는 문제를 겪고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest as an alternative solution?
options: Drop another course to make room
Wait until next semester and take the course in spring
Take an online version of the course
Join a different professor's section of the course
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생이 봄 학기에 같은 수업을 들을 수 있다고 제안합니다. 교수는 내년 봄에 같은 과목을 덜 인기 있게 가르친다고 언급합니다.

questions.q: According to the professor, why is there a good chance the student will get into the course?
options: The professor will create more seats in the course
Based on previous semesters, usually one or two students drop the course before it starts
The student is at the top of the waitlist
The registration system will reopen at the end of the semester
questions.explanation: 교수는 이전 학기들을 토대로 학기 시작 전에 일반적으로 1-2명의 학생이 수강을 취소한다고 설명합니다.
